title: Data Governance Specialist
description: Ensure enterprise data integrity, regulatory compliance (GDPR, HIPAA), data lineage, cataloging, and corporate metadata management.

goal.objective: Establish enterprise policies, lineage tracking, access guardrails, and quality frameworks that secure and elevate corporate data assets.

learn.summary: Master data catalog platforms (Collibra, Atlan, Alation), automated data lineage, data quality dimensions, GDPR/CCPA privacy standards, and master data management.
prerequisites: Understanding of relational databases and SQL

capstone_projects.description: Deploy an automated data governance scanner that flags unencrypted PII columns and monitors data quality SLAs across warehouses.

tree.description: Understand the core concepts, frameworks, and ethical considerations that form the bedrock of data governance, and define the specialist's role within an organization.

children.name: Core Data Governance Principles & Concepts
children.description: Dive into fundamental data governance concepts including data strategy, data assets, data domains, data policies, data standards, business glossaries, data definitions, data lifecycle management, data literacy, and fostering a data-driven culture.

children.description: Learn about various data governance frameworks (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK, CDMC, DCAM) and operating models (centralized, decentralized, federated). Understand how to design and implement an effective DG program structure.

resources.title: What is Data Governance? Data Governance Tutorial | Data Management | Simplilearn

children.name: Regulatory Landscape & Data Ethics
children.description: Examine key data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, LGPD) and industry-specific compliance requirements. Understand ethical considerations in data handling, usage, and responsible AI.

children.name: Emerging Data Regulations & AI Governance
children.description: Explore new and evolving data regulations (e.g., EU Data Act, Digital Markets Act, sector-specific mandates like financial services or healthcare data directives) and their implications for data governance. Understand principles of AI governance, bias detection, fairness, explainability, and ethical AI development within a data governance context.

tree.name: Core Skills and Implementation
tree.description: Build the practical skill stack for a Data Governance Specialist by understanding and implementing key governance capabilities through exercises and realistic scenarios.

resources.title: What are Data Governance Best Practices?

children.name: Data Catalog & Metadata Management
children.description: Master the principles of data cataloging, active vs. passive metadata management, data classification, tagging, business glossary creation, and technical metadata extraction. Learn to use tools for discovery, understanding, and linking data assets across the enterprise.

resources.title: Introduction to Collibra Data Governance Center
What is Data Governance and Metadata Management?

children.name: Data Lineage & Traceability
children.description: Understand how to map data flows, track data transformations, and establish end-to-end data lineage. Explore the importance of lineage for impact analysis, regulatory compliance, and troubleshooting.

resources.title: Data Lineage Explained: What, Why and How?

children.name: Data Quality Management
children.description: Learn to define, measure, monitor, and improve data quality. Cover data profiling, data quality rules, validation techniques, data cleansing, and the role of data quality in decision-making.

resources.title: Master Data Management and Data Quality Concepts

children.name: Data Ownership & Stewardship
children.description: Establish clear roles and responsibilities for data assets within an organization. Define data owners, data stewards, and their functions in managing data definitions, quality, security, and access.

resources.title: Data Ownership vs. Data Stewardship: What's the Difference?
Data Governance Roles and Responsibilities: Data Owners vs. Data Stewards

children.name: Data Access Control & Security Policies
children.description: Design and implement policies for secure data access, role-based access control (RBAC), and attribute-based access control (ABAC). Understand data masking, encryption, and anonymization concepts for sensitive data.

resources.title: Data Security and Protection Best Practices

children.name: Data Retention & Archiving Policies
children.description: Develop and enforce data retention schedules compliant with legal, regulatory, and business requirements. Understand data archiving strategies, data disposal best practices, and data lifecycle management.

children.name: Master Data Management (MDM) & Reference Data
children.description: Learn the principles and importance of Master Data Management (MDM) for creating a single, consistent, and accurate view of critical business entities (e.g., customers, products, suppliers). Understand reference data management, data consolidation strategies, data hierarchy management, and how MDM programs are structured to support enterprise data governance.

children.name: Data Architecture Fundamentals & Modern Data Platforms
children.description: Understand foundational data architecture concepts including traditional data warehouses, modern data lakes, data meshes, and data fabrics. Learn how data governance principles and controls are applied across different architectural patterns, cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), and streaming data environments. Explore the governance implications of microservices and APIs.

resources.title: Data Architecture Explained: Concepts & Best Practices
Data Architecture Explained | Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, Data Mesh & Data Fabric

tree.name: Production, Collaboration, and Operations
tree.description: Move beyond theoretical knowledge into the operational aspects of data governance: managing programs, automating workflows, ensuring continuous compliance, and resolving incidents in a production environment.

resources.title: What is a Data Steward? Data Governance

children.name: Implementing Data Governance Controls & Monitoring
children.description: Translate data governance policies into practical, enforceable controls within data platforms, databases, APIs, and applications. Implement monitoring mechanisms for policy adherence, data quality, access patterns, data loss prevention (DLP), and compliance reporting across the data landscape.

resources.title: How to Implement Data Governance Policies
Data Governance Tutorial For Beginners | Data Governance In Detail | Data Governance Explained | Simplilearn

children.name: Automated Governance Workflows & Tools
children.description: Explore how to automate data governance tasks using specialized tools and platforms. Focus on integrating data catalogs, lineage tools, and quality checks into CI/CD pipelines for data assets, data platforms, and orchestration tools for continuous governance and streamlined operations.

children.description: Develop robust processes for identifying, reporting, triaging, and resolving data governance incidents, such as data breaches, policy violations, data quality issues, or compliance failures. Focus on root cause analysis and preventative measures.

resources.title: Root Cause Analysis Techniques for Data Issues

children.name: Data Governance Metrics, KPIs, and Value Realization
children.description: Develop strategies for defining, tracking, and reporting on key performance indicators (KPIs) for data governance initiatives. Learn how to measure the effectiveness of DG programs, demonstrate tangible business value, quantify risk reduction, and create compelling dashboards and reports for executive stakeholders and continuous improvement.

children.description: Design and implement a comprehensive data governance solution for a simulated or real-world dataset. Document thoroughly with a README, diagrams, and a lessons-learned section.
